mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate levels (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) compress equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% (p-value < 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% over 3 months indicate contraction in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized) trigger aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals weakening consumer demand for residential construction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST declines over 3 months (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS above 3.0% and CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales decline below 530,000 million (RSAFS < 530000) over 3 months indicates weakening consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS falls below 530000 (p-value < 0.05 for positive returns).
